atoms.text: Collin decided to reach out to David to talk to him about the gossiping.

instruction.text: Follow the phone call and select the correct answers.

atoms.b: Collin! Are you calling for the reason I think you’re calling?
I hope so! So, just last year, we had that relay race where our old gym teacher’s shorts split in half. Ring a bell?

instruction.text: What could this saying be replaced with?

atoms.b: So, I heard that today in another gym class, it happened again! Guess he must really enjoy his fast food?
Woah, hold your horses. What’s causing you to have such a fit? You’re usually all ears with stuff like this...

b: ++the final annoyance that causes a person to lose their patience and become upset
the last time someone will ever talk again
the last piece of straw on a farm
++asking someone to wait a moment and think on their decision or opinion
asking someone to make a decision as quickly as possible
holding as many horses back as possible
to say something fitting to the situation
listening to something or someone without interest
having ears all over the place

atoms.b: What’s causing me to have such a fit? Your constant negativity and endless gossiping! I didn’t use to think much of it, but really... it’s pretty hurtful.
No it’s not. We’re just having ((++good_fun bad buns)). Everyone gossips anyway. As long as you keep it a secret, there’s no harm.
Just like you kept the hurtful things you said about me a secret?
Exactly. Think about how you would feel if I would’ve said those things about you. Sleep on it and get back to me. See you.
